notes.activity: battery central control and protection unit production
notes.before:
Nomenclature revision, 2026-10-19. Former activity name: battery central controls and protection, engineering reference. Former reference product: battery central controls and protection, engineering reference. Activity/product labels and supplier references only; coefficients, formulas, uncertainty, declared output and unit are unchanged. Original engineering assumptions, functional-unit basis and limitations remain below.

APPROVED FUNCTION-SPECIFIC BATTERY CONTROL ELECTRONICS, issue35, 2026-10-18. TI TIDA020076 public BOM https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/SLURB87; TI BQ79616PAPRQ1 material declaration https://www.ti.com/quality-reliability-packaging-download/report?opn=BQ79616PAPRQ1; TI CC2662 BCU guide https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/SWRU641. Preserve existing central0.49kg, module1.12kg or1.1kg/16 and residual-pack electronics mass/count budgets. Replace central and identified module-monitor boards, not unidentified residual pack electronics. Engineering monitor70g (1.1kg reference uses68.75g/board through mass scaling),16channelBQ79616one/70g instead of TI18channelBQ79718; this is a declared alternative, not an exact TI board replica or validated channel architecture. Source TIDA fitted passives134ceramiccapacitors(62x0402,27x0603,39x0805,6x1206),128resistors(63x0402,21x0603,4x0805,38x1206,2x2010). Assumed individual masses0402=1mg,0603=3mg,0805=10mg,1206=30mg,2010=60mg,ceramiccapacitor0805=15mg; component-specific manufacturer masses remain unknown. Monitoring bareboard100x100mm,6copperlayers35um,50percent retainedcopper,1.6mm1850kg/m3FR4; centralbareboard0.1m2,4layers samegeometry. Central490g size is legacy mass-constrained engineering reference, not manufacturer dimensions:validate area0.03-0.1m2,layer4-8 andparts independently. FR4 proxy60percentglass/40epoxy plus2g/m2soldermask;ENIGfinish1percentarea,5umNi,0.05umAu.95percentCu/glass/epoxyretention reference with matching waste; etching/process chemistry remains a gap,assume10kWh/m2 bareboard and1kWh/board finalassembly. Monitor20gconnectors,1.5gotherlogic,1gmagnetics,1gdiodes,0.4gRF/crystals,1gsolder;central100gconnectors,5glogic,2gcapacitors,3gresistors,5gsolder. Use existing constituent manufacturing proxies, so logic/resistor/ceramiccap/connector upstreamPd/Ta/Sb/Au remain and are not assumed absent. Remaining component mass explicitly retains a generic populated-board proxy; trace-metal completeness is NOT proven by bulk closure. TI declared366.484301mg BQpackage explicitly purchases Cu/Fe/Ni/Ag/Au/Pd/Pb/Zn/Mn/S/SiO2/epoxy/phenolic/carbonblack and fabricatedsilicondie once. Gold0.034234mg,Pd0.179949mg,Ag4.372259mg perpackage; no generic1percentgoldbondwire. Phosphorus0.048897mg unmodeled due to absent exact feed; mass/trace gap documented. Fabricatedwafer proxy270um allocation reference at2330kg/m3 (300um diagnostic alternative; fitted die geometry unverified) includes die manufacture, no duplicate elementalSi purchase. No new EOL:existing complete control mass treatment remains once. Component fabrication yields beyond bareboard, automobile qualification, functional reliability andfutureelectronics evolution remain gaps; sensitivity0.5-2xcomponentcounts andunknowncomponentmetalrecipes. This is a transparent engineering reference, not recovered manufacturer complete BOM.
PREVIOUS NOTES (retained as history; the correction above takes precedence):
APPROVED ENGINEERING CONTROL/THERMAL COVERAGE, item13, 2026-10-18. Wickerts corrected SI DOI10.1021/acssuschemeng.4c01782.s001 S26/S27; original Ellingsen2014 SI S39/S40, DOI10.1111/jiec.12072. Separate module monitoring from central protection: per16-module reference,1.1kg populated PCB monitors, central0.49kg populated PCB+2.8kg HV system+1.2kg LV system+.028kg fasteners=4.518kg. Use existing HV/LV/fastener process providers and generic populated through-hole PCB perkg; this is an explicit board-technology/material proxy rather than the source-specific board fabrication model. No whole BMS is added on top. Adopt one nominal10kg liquid-cooling assembly per reference: Al9.08, steel.23, PVC/rubber pipe.0096, thermal pad.2 (silicon.06, glass.02, ABS.12), ethylene glycol.48kg; source-rounded sum9.9996kg. Metal working/injection services are included; 100percent retention of listed finished materials is assumed. No stationary rack housing/container, common vehicle body or roadway is added. Monitoring/protection/cooling are added once as a unit-valued capacity input; kg module and matching waste remain separate, so density learning does not shrink fixed controls. Central and cooling hardware are conservatively co-replaced with each delivered pack; longer independent hardware life is not established. End-of-life uses the existing generic used Li-ion route for15.6176kg of auxiliary hardware per reference, without recovery credits; this is a treatment proxy for controls/cooling, not proof of chemistry-specific recovery. Source thermal duty, pump/radiator performance, protection ratings, inverter/pack interface, full outer pack enclosure and vehicle-specific module topology remain coverage/design gaps. The SIB cell-mass-equivalent module retains its existing18.768kg cell+6.203kg module hardware reference; it is not a demonstrated integer21700-cell topology. LiS uses the corrected19.306152kg cell+6.203kg module hardware. These are engineering references, not fleet-validated designs; use0.5-2x auxiliary-size and independent-replacement-life sensitivities.
notes.prefix: APPROVED CENTRAL-CONTROL FASTENER AND MASS RECONCILIATION, 2026-10-27. The shared central-control reference uses 0.0028 kg fasteners rather than 0.028 kg, retaining 0.49 kg mounted board, 2.8 kg HV equipment and 1.2 kg LV equipment: nominal reference mass 4.4928 kg instead of 4.518 kg. This remains a qualified material reference, not a verified complete manufacturer BOM, actual circuit topology or literal fractional controller count. Preserve all other central-reference inputs, suppliers and the one-unit output. Original technosphere and biosphere declarations both remain 3.9. Fixed counts and other recipes remain unchanged except for the explicitly coupled mass accounting. Historical source text follows unchanged.

Nomenclature revision, 2026-10-19. Former activity name: battery monitoring and central controls, NMC622, engineering reference. Former reference product: battery monitoring and central controls, NMC622, engineering reference. Activity/product labels and supplier references only; coefficients, formulas, uncertainty, declared output and unit are unchanged. Original engineering assumptions, functional-unit basis and limitations remain below.

APPROVED AUXILIARY BATTERY BOARD BOUNDARY, issue58, 2026-10-18. TI TIDA020076 SLURB87 component classes; TI package declarations and KEMET/Bourns references documented in issues55-57; Wickerts2024 DOI10.1021/acssuschemeng.4c01782.s001 and Ellingsen2014 DOI10.1111/jiec.12072 regulator/board allowances. Additional interface BOM below is explicitly engineered,not manufacturermeasured. Replace the remaining0.84-1.03kg/reference generic mountedTHT regulator allowance by a scoped auxiliarypower/interface assembly, distinct from16x70g modulemonitorboards and the490g centralboard. No second fullBMS,centralprocessor,monitorASIC,tractionconverter or duplicated board area is added. Onekg finishedreference has glass0.24,epoxy0.16,copper0.18,ferrite0.15,Alheatspreaders0.10,nylonconnectors/insulation0.09,solder0.03,Class2capacitors0.025,nonzeroresistors0.005,logicpackages0.01 and regulatorpackages0.01kg. These are explicit function-level mass allowances with unknown actual counts/ratings; materialcomposition is an engineering sensitivity reference, not measured exact auxiliaryboards. 40%barelaminate and combined18%Cu include boardtracks and inductorwindings, so no additional wholeinductors or mountedboard proxy. Use package unit counts derived from actual selected package masses, and documented ceramic/resistor families; retain real preciousmetals without genericZn-as-Sb. Maintain total original regulator allowance and paired complete-control disposal, not invent a source-measured mass reduction. Replace the small unresolved generic mountedcomponent remainders inside existing central/moduleboards by this explicitly identified auxiliary-component analogue at unchanged residual mass; it includes laminate by engineering transfer, and is not evidence that the residual is an actual second fitted board. Their detailed fittedpart inputs remain, no recount. Retain uncertainty as actual-component coveragegaps: transformer/diode/isolationpart ratings,trace metals,laminate layout,thermaldesign,assemblyyield and exact topology. Test zero-to-double additional interface allowance as an explicit coverage sensitivity. Component supplymanufacture is separate from boardassembly2kWh/kg;100%final assemblyretention assumed. No chassis, native inventory mutation or extra EOL on top of currentcompletecontrol treatment.
PREVIOUS NOTES (retained as history; the correction above takes precedence):
APPROVED FUNCTION-SPECIFIC BATTERY CONTROL ELECTRONICS, issue35, 2026-10-18. TI TIDA020076 public BOM https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/SLURB87; TI BQ79616PAPRQ1 material declaration https://www.ti.com/quality-reliability-packaging-download/report?opn=BQ79616PAPRQ1; TI CC2662 BCU guide https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/SWRU641. Preserve existing central0.49kg, module1.12kg or1.1kg/16 and residual-pack electronics mass/count budgets. Replace central and identified module-monitor boards, not unidentified residual pack electronics. Engineering monitor70g (1.1kg reference uses68.75g/board through mass scaling),16channelBQ79616one/70g instead of TI18channelBQ79718; this is a declared alternative, not an exact TI board replica or validated channel architecture. Source TIDA fitted passives134ceramiccapacitors(62x0402,27x0603,39x0805,6x1206),128resistors(63x0402,21x0603,4x0805,38x1206,2x2010). Assumed individual masses0402=1mg,0603=3mg,0805=10mg,1206=30mg,2010=60mg,ceramiccapacitor0805=15mg; component-specific manufacturer masses remain unknown. Monitoring bareboard100x100mm,6copperlayers35um,50percent retainedcopper,1.6mm1850kg/m3FR4; centralbareboard0.1m2,4layers samegeometry. Central490g size is legacy mass-constrained engineering reference, not manufacturer dimensions:validate area0.03-0.1m2,layer4-8 andparts independently. FR4 proxy60percentglass/40epoxy plus2g/m2soldermask;ENIGfinish1percentarea,5umNi,0.05umAu.95percentCu/glass/epoxyretention reference with matching waste; etching/process chemistry remains a gap,assume10kWh/m2 bareboard and1kWh/board finalassembly. Monitor20gconnectors,1.5gotherlogic,1gmagnetics,1gdiodes,0.4gRF/crystals,1gsolder;central100gconnectors,5glogic,2gcapacitors,3gresistors,5gsolder. Use existing constituent manufacturing proxies, so logic/resistor/ceramiccap/connector upstreamPd/Ta/Sb/Au remain and are not assumed absent. Remaining component mass explicitly retains a generic populated-board proxy; trace-metal completeness is NOT proven by bulk closure. TI declared366.484301mg BQpackage explicitly purchases Cu/Fe/Ni/Ag/Au/Pd/Pb/Zn/Mn/S/SiO2/epoxy/phenolic/carbonblack and fabricatedsilicondie once. Gold0.034234mg,Pd0.179949mg,Ag4.372259mg perpackage; no generic1percentgoldbondwire. Phosphorus0.048897mg unmodeled due to absent exact feed; mass/trace gap documented. Fabricatedwafer proxy300um2330kg/m3 includes die manufacture, no duplicate elementalSi purchase. No new EOL:existing complete control mass treatment remains once. Component fabrication yields beyond bareboard, automobile qualification, functional reliability andfutureelectronics evolution remain gaps; sensitivity0.5-2xcomponentcounts andunknowncomponentmetalrecipes. This is a transparent engineering reference, not recovered manufacturer complete BOM.

BATTERY WORKBOOK LINK COMPLETION AFTER COMBINED IMPORT, approved batch23-32, 2026-10-18. Full default import checks product identities in workbook order. The central controls assembly is supplied by later lci-batteries-LiS.xlsx, so explicit product metadata is needed to declare this valid forward link. Add a product column equal to the existing reference product on affected control-package header/exchange rows; this declares an exact intended product, not a numeric substitute or unresolved wildcard. Validate again against the complete imported database. NMC811 Crenna cell uses the existing native Chinese cathode market when available (ecoinvent3.9+). In3.8 add a public fallback market with the identical native identity, supplying one kg of the existing public supplemental GLO cathode. Normal duplicate removal suppresses this fallback when the native market exists; use explicit product metadata so its legacy input is not prematurely looked up before the fallback is removed. Foreground manufacturing and source quantities otherwise unchanged. The selected anode remains chemistry-specific; native cathode composition is the declared background proxy for newer versions. This is a linking correction, not a new technology-performance or metal-content assumption. Full combined import and all-version link checks are required; do not treat isolated existence checks as proof of import-order compatibility.

APPROVED ENGINEERING PACK CONTROL BOUNDARY, item14, 2026-10-18. Dai etal2018, Argonne ANL/ESD-18/4, https://publications.anl.gov/anlpubs/2018/10/146906.pdf, Table8 BEV material inventory; Wickerts corrected SI S26 and Ellingsen2014 BMS component function split. Replace opaque whole-pack supply in capacity markets by explicit public-source cell+non-electronic module/pack hardware, plus one separately named monitoring/central-protection package. This avoids combining module monitors with an undifferentiated whole BMS. Dai per-pack module electronics1.12kg are represented ONCE by populated-PCB proxy; assume4kg of the reported pack electronics correspond to the former undifferentiated BMS, remove that proxy and substitute one central4.518kg engineering package (0.49board+2.8HV+1.2LV+.028fasteners) with no module monitoring. Remaining pack electronics=(Dai pack electronics-4kg), represented once by the same generic PCB proxy with unspecified function; the4kg split is an engineering function assumption, not a source component breakdown. The inherited LTO cell source states60Wh/kg while the configured85Wh/kg remains an explicit unresolved performance assumption. Thermal mass uses Dai coolant, assumed50/50 ethylene glycol/water; module aluminium includes source thermal interface, while hoses/pump/control thermal ratings remain gaps. Hardware materials are retained mass with100percent assembly retention reference and generic working/injection services; source rounding is resolved by adding listed components, not silently forcing source totals. No native proprietary pack inventory is copied or numerically subtracted. Generic PCB, insulation proxies (module glass fibre reinforced plastic; pack HDPE), material grades and manufacturing energy remain engineering limitations. NMC532/NMC955/LTO use NMC622 non-cell geometry as an explicit proxy, retaining their own existing cell supplier. No claim of chemistry-specific validated outer-pack geometry. Use each declared cell-baseline specific energy (.16LFP,.18NMC111,.20NMC532,.24NMC622,.28NMC811/NCA,.34NMC955,.085LTO,.13LMO kWh/kg), correcting small mismatches between historical rounded share metadata/formulas: gross reference kWh=source cellmass*that baseline. Thus the historical23.5kWh Dai label is not forced onto a different configured cell density. Fixed controls use unit input1/referencekWh; scalable hardware and equal negative waste usekg. Future density learning changes kg hardware/waste while fixed controls and their own waste stay fixed. Controls are conservatively co-replaced with delivered packs; independent life remains unknown. No common glider/roadway or new recovery credits. Sensitivities: central split3-5kg, module monitoring0.5-2x, fixed versus scalable non-cell materials. These engineering packs resolve accounting duplication but are not verified vehicle designs. Chemistry=NMC622; geometry proxy=NMC622; cellmass=108.03kg, scalablehardware=145.74kg, assumed cellbaseline=0.24kWh/kg, grossreference=25.9272kWh, fixedcontrolmass=6.538kg. Retained listed hardware material coefficients sum1kg/kg; upstream cell/processing yields are not overwritten. Raw source rounding and cell-specific gaps remain in those providers.

Reuse the existing RER cooling system production, for Li-O2 battery reference with radiator, manifolds, clamps, pipe fitting, thermal pad, glycol and freight. Preserve 0.08707503369776846 kg cooling per kg battery (29.07 kg per 333.85 kg reference system), including its formula and cached value. This supersedes the former GLO 7 kg aluminium plus 22.07 kg pure-glycol choice only for this standalone manufacturing input. The RER composition is an inherited engineering proxy, not verified battery-specific thermal design or performance. Its nominal material sum of 0.99996 kg retains source rounding without invented closure. Preserve the approved final-assembly electricity, all other exchanges, output, every helper and every other consumer. Retain the GLO helper for existing other uses. Control alignment remains separate; this supplier change does not establish complete recipe equivalence or authorize future learning. Original technosphere and biosphere declarations both remain 3.9. Historical source text follows unchanged.

APPROVED Li-O2 FINAL-ASSEMBLY ELECTRICITY, 2026-10-27. Apply the 0.41 MJ final-assembly allowance once per complete 333.85 kg manufacturing reference: 0.41/3.6/333.85 kWh per kg battery. Retain the curated scalar 0.00034113790291714506 kWh/kg, numerically equivalent within rounding. Use the source US medium-voltage electricity proxy. This is final complete-system assembly, separate from existing cell processing and casing manufacture; do not also apply it per cell, per kg as a full 0.41 MJ, or per delivered/lifetime kWh. The 333.85 kg detailed component sum is an adopted engineering basis, not a resolution of conflicting 321 kg system and 267 kg pack source headlines. Preserve all eight existing exchanges, including the zero duplicate-retirement fragment, output, upstream recipes and all consumers. Cooling and control differences from curated CLIC remain separate; this addition does not establish whole-recipe equivalence or authorize future learning. Original field declarations for technosphere and biosphere both remain 3.9. Historical source text follows unchanged.

APPROVED Li-O2 HIERARCHICAL ENGINEERING RECONCILIATION, item18, 2026-10-18. Wang,Deng,Yuan2020 DOI10.1016/j.jclepro.2020.121339, SI TablesS3/S4/S5/S16; Kanthal resistance-wire datasheet https://www.kanthal.com/products/datasheets/material-datasheets/wire/resistance-heating-wire-and-resistance-wire/nikrothal-80/. Adopt TableS3 detailed retained geometry: cell182.6kg, module hardware19.51, pack hardware43.67, oxygen tank55, BMS4,cooling29.07 =>333.85kg at63.5grosskWh. This conflicts with source headline321kg/267kg pack and with TableS5 gross material figures; do not mix those bases. Scalable cell/module/pack hardware=245.78kg; fixed-per-reference auxiliary hardware=88.07kg. Listed component masses, not proportional normalization of contradictory gross LCI tables, define this engineering reference. Known cell ingredients total182.59kg;0.01kg unspecified cathode catalyst remains a documented composition gap, not zero-metal proof. The sourceS4 fluoropolymer binder is not substituted for the unidentified S3 catalyst; binder quantity/fate is also unresolved, and that old process input is disabled in this reference. Electrolyte total59.11kg is split by inheritedS4 salt:solvent ratio.016:.308; LiClO4 process is the inherited salt provider, and ethylene-glycol dimethyl ether remains an explicitly imperfect TEGDME solvent proxy. Lithium protective film/pouch/separator process recipes remain inherited and unvalidated. Collector feed is1kg metal/kg foil at100percent reference retention; matching rolling and restored facility proxy are preserved. Terminal metal fractions are2.44kgAl/10.5kg and8.06kgCu/10.5kg, with matching working services; old overlapping gross feed and implied manufacturing scrap are disabled under the explicit100percent retention reference. Module and pack known material inputs followS3, with no new gross-yield claim. Module monitor.67kg is counted once; BMS4kg is assigned to central protection only using4/4.518 of the separate engineering central-control package. This functional repartition is an assumption, not a source breakdown. Cooling uses7kg Al plus22.07kg pureEG reference (alternative50/50 coolant is a sensitivity); thermal duty, pump/hoses remain gaps. Heater.2kg uses an idealized binary80Ni/20Cr resistance-alloy reference, consistent with a NiCr class but not a complete measured battery heater/Nikrothal composition; electronic/heater construction is unresolved. Preserve historical source-specific S16 recycling coefficients without new recovery credits. Capacity purchases245.78/63.5kg scalable hardware plus one auxiliary lifecycle unit per63.5kWh. Its negative waste equals scalable mass; auxiliary unit carries its own88.07kg waste. Future density factors scale hardware and its waste together; fixed auxiliary manufacture/treatment stay paired. Existing relative density learning is retained as an engineering ratio; absolute cell energy63.5/182.6=.347754655kWh/kg and fixed recipe are not a validated future design. Original full-battery market remains manufacturing-only at333.85kg component-sum basis; capacity uses the separately named hardware market. Vehicle energy/lifetime allocation is unchanged. Source contradictions, catalyst, solvent, future structure and recovery performance remain explicit gaps.

APPROVED Li-O2 SINGLE RECYCLING BOUNDARY, 2026-10-18. Wang, Deng and Yuan (2020), DOI 10.1016/j.jclepro.2020.121339, supporting information Table S16, explicitly describes recycling per 1 kg Li-O2 battery system. Its six treatment coefficients are retained. Set the former -1/321 kg/kg internal treatment fragment to a deterministic zero and apply end of life only at market for battery capacity, Li-ion, Li-O2: the full purchased battery mass is sent to treatment of LiO2 battery, for recycling (RER; waste LiO2 battery). Standalone manufacture is manufacturing-only. DefaultInventory may retain the zero exchange; it contributes no treatment flow. Do not add a second generic Li-ion route. This restores a single historical source-specific accounting route; treatment yields, whole-system mass normalization, modern recovery and primary/secondary shares remain unvalidated. No new recovery credit or change to manufacturing recipes, density or lifetime.

Toyota Mirai2 manufacturer https://newsroom.toyota.eu/introducing-the-all-new-toyota-mirai/; AKASOL AKASYSTEM15OEM37PRC May2021 https://www.act-news.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/210525_LowRes_AK_Datenblatt_AKASystem_15-OEM-37-PRC_2021_2159x2794mm_EN.pdf; Dai2018 Table8 https://publications.anl.gov/anlpubs/2018/10/146906.pdf. Match complete physical pack mass and nominal energy, not the changing BEV MIX. Car reference44.6kg/1.2432kWh (=310.8V*4Ah/1000),31.5kW for10seconds; truck reference238kg/25kWh,36kW continuous charge,50kW continuous RMS discharge,150kW10second discharge. Retain existing vehicle capacities/power sizing and lifetime replacement counts. These manufacturer ratings are NOT inferred from chemistry or treated as continuous pulse ratings. Material split remains an engineering proxy:70percent cells, as in the truck sizing source; assume the same70percent for cars. Car air-cooled reference excludes liquid coolant; unknown fan/duct design is embedded in the residual housing proxy, not independently validated. No module electronics are added on top of the central package; missing distributed monitoring is a coverage gap. All retained material inputs use100percent assembly retention reference; generic working services additional. Equal negative used-battery treatment equals complete manufactured reference mass, including controls, once; no duplicated control waste. Reallocate the freed 0.0252 kg per complete pack through the existing residual-hardware proportions, including matching working services. This preserves an engineering allocation; it does not establish a measured residual hardware composition. Original technosphere and biosphere declarations both remain 3.10. Fixed counts and other recipes remain unchanged except for the explicitly coupled mass accounting. Historical source text follows unchanged.
